answers.core: Area intersection is a part of core physics.
answers.workaround:
Current workaround is adding a script to `Area` that would communicate with the entering body (so sort of reimplementing signals in script), but this requires adding these scripts to every area of interest in the game, which is a productivity bottleneck, and may even affect performance.
Another workaround is attaching an `Area` to the Body in question, setting its shape to the same shape the `Body` uses, and attaching this `Area`'s signals to `Body`'s script. But this is very clunky and draws an extra gizmo per body in debug view.

title: Add area intersection signals to PhysicsBody nodes
